name: Error
caption: Error

configuration.description: The error message raised when the flow reaches this step. The key is case-sensitive and capitalised ('Error'). Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}.

outputs.name: Errormessage
outputs.when: declared only; never populated because the step always fails

rules.check: A step whose JSON has terminating=true must have no next step in its sequence and no edges
rules.message: Step "%1" is a terminating step but has a successor – terminating steps must end the path.

notes: The step always fails the flow. With the key present, the error text is the resolved message. Without the key, it fails with 'No error message configured.'.
At runtime only the key's presence is checked. An empty string still fails the step, but with an empty message, which is unhelpful in the execution log. Treat a non-empty message as required.
There is no editor or publish check of the message: the message field is optional in the configuration dialog.
The publish-time terminating check reads the step's own 'terminating' flag from the JSON. Keep terminating=true so that misplaced successors are reported.
